request.prompt: One realistic weathered driftwood log resting horizontally, about 1.6 metres long, with a naturally twisting trunk, three short broken branch stubs, deep flowing grain channels, eroded knots and irregular split ends. Substantial connected wood, gently curved silhouette, no thin twigs, no leaves, no roots spreading onto a ground plane. Neutral object for landscape and interior display studies. Entire log visible with generous margin, isolated on pure white, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even studio lighting, crisp sculptural physical geometry, no text, no cast shadow.
